limitations: Display/search/export overlays preserve original directory facts, planner stops and saved itinerary snapshots.
All 332 entries received an editorial and media research pass. Retained earlier source dates are not represented as fresh source verification; some blocked sources support only a short overview.
Licensed exact-place photographs were not found for every location. Missing photographs use the existing fallback.
Videos were checked against official metadata, descriptions and embed eligibility, not full footage. Streaming playback did not advance in the headless test; external YouTube links remain available.
Current admission, opening hours, access and practical conditions remain unknown or estimated unless independently sourced. A reviewed description does not verify adjacent facts.

validation.unitIntegration: 80/80 passed, including catalog categories/geography/scheduling, original record integrity, saved-trip immutability and account ownership
validation.builds: Sites/Vinext and native Next.js/Vercel builds passed; TypeScript passed
validation.browsers: Six baseline suites passed on Vinext; final place-media, Discover and account browser suites passed on native Next.js (desktop/mobile). Account flow uses UI network fixtures, not a live Google login.
validation.localProductionOrigin: Use http://localhost:5173 for native Next.js browser tests so browser Origin matches the local production request URL; use LAKBAY_TEST_ORIGIN for Discover/media/account suites. No origin guard was bypassed.
validation.images: All 182 metadata-rich image records decoded; reserved dimensions match. Six original seed photos are retained (four also have rich records). Contact sheets visually reviewed.
validation.links: Saved batch reports distinguish reachability from factual verification. Final correction pass: 204 links, 152 HTTP 200, 48 rate-limited, two HTTP 403, one HTTP 404, one timeout. Optimized local images still load.
validation.video: 515 associations have official metadata/description/embed-eligibility checks. Full footage and end-to-end streaming playback are not verified; native players have external fallback links.
validation.lint: New media/data/schema/export/test files have no ESLint errors; one expected native-img recommendation. Modified existing Discover/bookmark components retain the same seven pre-existing lint errors as HEAD (confirmed against copies of HEAD).
validation.audit: Seven inherited wrapper findings remain in ui-audit.json; no new audit findings.

remainingWork: 210 current locations still need an approved exact-place photograph or a resolved source/download review. The historical 148-place pass and this 212-gap follow-up remain separate; see docs/place-enrichment/cover-completion/.
33 places have no selected video; some other places have one resource rather than two or three. Relevance is not inferred to meet a quota.
Many overviews are shorter than 100 words because supporting detail was limited; nine entries explicitly record limited-evidence status.

Review unavailable sources when access returns. The old Davao CPDO Sectoral Studies URL is now 404; the official current download index is https://cpdoapps.davaocity.gov.ph/requirements, but the replacement PDF could not be reviewed in this pass.
Verify playback in a normal browser/network and perform live Google sign-in after deployment if desired; fixtures do not establish a successful production login.
Commit/push the changes and deploy to Vercel. No additional environment variables, paid APIs or migrations are required for this Discover update.

validation.focusedBatches: All six batches passed place-content schemas, unique IDs and image decoding/reserved-dimension checks after publication.
validation.sourceReview: All 25 published photos visually inspected; each individual Commons file-page declaration, creator and license reviewed. Source/rights evidence and rejection reasons retained in the decisions. No unreviewed Flickr image published.
validation.preservation: 82/82 unit/integration tests passed, including hashes of all non-photo editorial content, video file, original directory modules, and every previously referenced local photo asset; prior photo metadata is unchanged.
validation.browser: All 25 new photos passed card and detail-page image-loading checks at 1440 and 390 pixels on native Next.js. Local src, alt text, reserved dimensions, source credits and no horizontal overflow checked. Existing media/browser suite also passed, including fallback behavior.
validation.builds: Sites/Vinext build, native Next.js/Vercel build and TypeScript passed. The builds share .next generation; finish with the native build before typecheck.
validation.lint: All changed/new publishing/research/progress scripts and photo tests pass targeted ESLint with no warnings or errors.

coverPhotoPass.limitation: A completed source search is not complete photo coverage or proof that no reusable photo exists. Instagram remains independent. No generic or generated substitutes are counted as exact-place photos.
